description: This file contains data access classes for User and Note entities, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting user and note records, with user scoping and pagination support.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Provides data access methods for User entities, including creation and retrieval by email.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Provides data access methods for Note entities, including create, list with pagination, retrieve, update, and delete operations, scoped to users.

methods.name: User create_user(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with the specified email and password, handling duplicate email conflicts.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a User by email, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Note create_note(user: User, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note associated with a user.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Note],dict] list_notes(user: User, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Returns a list of notes for a user with pagination metadata.

methods.name: Note get_note(user: User, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note for a user by note ID, raises NotFound if not present.

methods.name: Note update_note(user: User, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of a user's note.
